training: All three arms retrained from matched initial weights with the frozen Phase8 12+8 recipe, original BCE and focal auxiliary, AdamW, corruption, packing and validation-loss pass. No local MLP retraining or frozen-embedding proxy. Final epochs only, no early selection or search.
query: Existing normalized ball XY only. Shared two-query residual MLP 2->16->64, final layer zero, added to learned seeds. Masked XY sanitized to zero before MLP; unavailable ball uses learned seeds alone. No temporal or new kinematic features.
capacity: Exactly the same extra 1136 parameters, MLP fed constant [1,1] for every frame, independent of XY and availability. Same fixed-query residual parameterization; not an alternative ball-aware representation.
decoder: Fixed HMM strength0.5, same train-only priors for all arms, no candidate adaptation, Platt or decoder search. Calibration partition reserved and unused.
selection: Each own validation only: original plus eligible arms passing existing guards, short recall +.01 and robust +.005 versus original; ball also robust>=capacity+.005. Both seals before test. Architecture supported only if ball passes BOTH folds. No automatic expansion. Test is one descriptive final pass of the prefixed three arms.
reference: A is a fresh paired replica of ST+TCN IDSSE-only without local MLP. Historical teacher and local8 outputs retained as provenance, not used to initialize candidates or choose variants. Compact training may accumulate differences from old unpacked trajectories.
official_assets: Prohibited including discovery/availability. Explicit existing public IDSSE paths only. Historical checkpoints, sources, protocols and evaluator read-only. CPU FP32, no MLX/AMP/compile/MPS.
